correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md proves the transfer map is piecewise triangular with unit Jacobian, so couples uniform order/chain volume. Conditioning on all other coordinates makes X_v uniform on [L_v,U_v] and Y_v uniform on [0,U_v−L_v], giving covariance exactly by total variance. Order-polytope lattice closure makes its uniform density MTP2; FKG implies covariance≥0. Conditional slices ordered by X_v satisfy Holley cross-lattice inequality, making ℓ(t)=E[L|X_v=t], ν(t)=E[U|X_v=t] monotone and nonconstant when v has both a predecessor and a successor. Strict Chebyshev covariance then yields strictness; at extreme vertices one endpoint is constant. Equal-volume linear-extension simplices with Dirichlet order statistics establish the rational formula and the 1/80 chain example. Independently recomputed exactly the three-chain gap 1/80; source check_order_chain_inertia.py enumerates 5230 naturally labeled posets to n=6 and 250 n=7 cases, not a universal proof.
